scope: Ingestion status CLI error output and offline help

behavior.persisted_errors: Ingestion-log and chain-indexer error columns show a redacted marker when an error is present; stored diagnostics are never printed.
behavior.filters: Existing failed-record filtering and status columns remain unchanged.
behavior.offline_help: The module-qualified CLI uses the package-qualified database adapter lazily, so --help works without importing database configuration or loading SOPS secrets.

coverage: ingestion-log output redacts persisted provider diagnostics
indexer-status output redacts persisted provider diagnostics
failed-record SQL filtering and connection cleanup remain intact
module help starts without database or secret loading

limitations: No database, provider, or service was contacted.
The CLI preserves error presence but does not expose historical raw diagnostics.
